results.content: Published Time: 2022-04-15T12:17:46+00:00 What are the rules to simplify K-Map? Top 5 Websites for Academic Research Home » What are the rules to simplify K-Map? What are the rules to simplify K-Map? by Goseeko Education02/06/2025 by Goseeko Education_8,593_ views * The K-Map is used to simplify the Boolean Functions in a very easy way. * Hence this method was named K-Map. * This is a graphical method consisting of 2 n cells for n variables. K-Maps for 2 to 5 Variables For reducing the smaller number of variables we can use Boolean identities. Now we will understand how to reduce 2 variables to 5 variables using K-map. As we have two variables the number of cells will become 2 2 cells. Hence, 4 cells will be there for two variable K-map. As we have three variables the number of cells will become 2 3 cells. Hence, 8 cells will be there for three variable K-map. * If we group two adjacent min terms then the possible combinations are {(m 0, m 1), (m 1, m 3), (m 3, m 2), (m 2, m 0), (m 4, m 5), (m 5, m 7), (m 7, m 6), (m 6, m 4), (m 0, m 4), (m 1, m 5), (m 3, m 7) and (m 2, m 6)}. Hence, now the K-map is reduced from a 3 variable to 2 variables. As we have four variables the number of cells will become 2 4 cells. Hence, 16 cells will be there for four variable K-map. * When the value of w=0, then the 4 variable K-map becomes three variable K-map. Rules for simplifying K-maps: * First of all we need to select K-map depending upon the number of variables. * When the Boolean function has all Max terms then we place 0 at the respective Max term cell. * When the Boolean function is in PoS form then we place 0 at the respective Max term cell so that the given sum is valid. * The number of possibilities are 2 n * The value of n tells the number of variables of the Boolean Function.
